niche_preference_profile: This user prefers clean, airy, and highly legible interfaces with strong visual hierarchy, clear primary actions, and enough content density to feel complete. They like light backgrounds more than dark ones in general, concise and friendly copy, prominent buttons and toggles, and layouts that feel organized and purposeful rather than sparse, fragmented, or overly verbose.

criteria.description: Clear, strongly emphasized hierarchy with one dominant title/card/action and minimal competing elements.
Short, direct, task-focused copy that is easy to scan and avoids verbose explanation.
A highly visible, clearly actionable primary CTA or main control that stands out immediately.
Controls that look active, usable, and easy to act on, with visible toggles and per-item actions.
Well-organized sections and grouped content that feel structured and purposeful rather than fragmented.
A balanced, moderately open layout that feels spacious but still populated and complete.
